description: Foundation for the new look, independent of FEAT-001 (may run after it; no shared files except tests that construct HabitWithStatus). Bundle Cormorant Garamond + Lora as assets, remove Geist and phosphor_flutter, rebuild lib/core/theme tokens + theme as LIGHT ONLY with the classical palette, make the app shell light-only, and mechanically fix every existing widget/test so the codebase compiles and stays green. The pretty restyle of widgets/pages is FEAT-003; here existing widgets only get the minimum token/icon renames (inkFaint->outline, accentSoft->accentTint, onInk/onAccent/raised->paper or accentInk, skeleton->track, shadow removed, PhosphorIcons->Icons.*). Plan sections 1, 2, 3, 5 (theme/app shell) and 9 (theme tests) are the spec.
steps: Read plan.md sections 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9. Read lib/core/theme/app_tokens.dart, app_theme.dart, lib/app.dart, test/core/theme/*.dart, test/helpers/pump_app.dart.

Download the 6 TTFs and 2 licence files from the exact URLs in plan.md section 2 into assets/fonts/ with `curl -fSL -o`; verify each TTF with `file` (TrueType), `xxd -l 4` = 0001 0000 and size > 50KB, and each licence contains 'SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE'. If a URL fails use the fallback chain in section 2 and record it in findings.

Delete assets/fonts/Geist-Regular.ttf, Geist-Medium.ttf, Geist-SemiBold.ttf and the Geist OFL.txt. Edit pubspec.yaml: replace the Geist `fonts:` block and `assets:` list with the CormorantGaramond + Lora declaration from plan.md section 2. Run `flutter pub remove phosphor_flutter` then `flutter pub get`.

Rewrite lib/core/theme/app_tokens.dart with the exact token set in plan.md section 1 (paper, ink, inkMuted, inkStrong, track, outline #8A8686, hairline, accent, accentTint, accentInk, danger), AppSpacing (screenMargin 26), AppRadii (control 4, strip 20), AppTextTokens with family constants 'CormorantGaramond'/'Lora' and the text styles listed there (tabular figures on numerals). Delete AppTokens.dark and the removed members. Keep copyWith/lerp and `context.tokens` with a light fallback. Only this file may contain hex colours.

Rewrite lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart: only AppTheme.light(); delete dark(); light-only overlayStyle(); theme pieces exactly as listed in plan.md section 5 (no filledButtonTheme, outlined 4dp gold buttons min height 52, 48dp icon buttons, 4dp outlined inputs, dark floating pill snackbar, hairline dialog, hairline divider, gold 2dp progress indicator, tooltip).

Edit lib/app.dart: remove darkTheme, set themeMode ThemeMode.light on MaterialApp.router and the bootstrap shell, light-only overlay, replace PhosphorIconsRegular.cloudSlash with Icons.cloud_off_outlined. Keep BootstrapGate behaviour (loader / ErrorView with the real BootstrapException message / Retry).

Mechanically fix every other lib/ file that no longer compiles (habit_tile, animated_check, day_chip, points_picker, new_habit_button, state_views, progress_header, app_top_bar, habit_detail_page, add_habit_page, today_page, confirm_delete_dialog, app_transitions): rename removed tokens per the mapping above, swap Phosphor icons for Material icons (check->Icons.check, x->Icons.close, arrowLeft->Icons.arrow_back, plus/minus->Icons.add/Icons.remove, trash->Icons.delete_outline, arrowCounterClockwise->Icons.undo, warningCircle->Icons.error_outline, cloudSlash->Icons.cloud_off_outlined). Replace any FilledButton usage with OutlinedButton so no filled button remains. Do not restyle layouts yet.

Rewrite test/core/theme/app_tokens_test.dart and app_theme_test.dart for the new tokens/theme (exact palette values, WCAG ratios per plan.md section 1: ink/inkMuted/accentInk/danger >= 4.5 on paper, paper on inkStrong >= 4.5, accentInk on accentTint >= 4.5, outline >= 3.0, accent >= 3.0; Material 3; Lora/Cormorant families; outlined 4dp buttons >= 48dp tall; 48dp icon buttons; 4dp outline inputs; light-only overlay; context.tokens fallback). Update test/helpers/pump_app.dart (drop brightness/darkTheme, themeMode light) and every caller. Remove only the dark-theme cases in app_theme_test, app_tokens_test and accessibility_themed_test, and append each removal with a reason to /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment/.agents/tasks/test-changes.md (create it). Update tests that reference PhosphorIcons (state_views_test, streak_row_test, habit_detail_page_test) to the Icons.* equivalents.
Run `dart format .`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test test/architecture_test.dart`, `flutter test`. Fix failures by updating tests to the new tokens, never by deleting assertions.
acceptance_criteria: assets/fonts contains the 6 verified TTFs and 2 OFL licence files, no Geist files remain; pubspec.yaml declares families CormorantGaramond and Lora and lists the licence assets; pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock no longer mention phosphor_flutter; no google_fonts dependency was added.
AppTokens exposes exactly the classical token set; AppTokens.dark and AppTheme.dark() do not exist; MaterialApp uses ThemeMode.light and no darkTheme.
grep for `phosphor`, `Geist`, `AppTokens.dark`, `AppTheme.dark`, `darkTheme`, `FilledButton` in lib/ test/ pubspec.yaml returns nothing.
Hex colours exist only in lib/core/theme/app_tokens.dart (design_rules_test still passes at this stage or is minimally adjusted, full rewrite is FEAT-003).
Theme and token tests assert the new palette, contrast ratios, 4dp outlined buttons and light-only theme; test-changes.md lists every removed test case.
flutter analyze clean, flutter test green, architecture test green.
verification: cd /Users/macbook/Desktop/Assignment && flutter pub get && flutter analyze
findings: Done. Fonts: the user supplied static TTFs in assets/fonts (sandbox network was down, curl failed with DNS errors, so nothing was downloaded from the plan URLs; my later curl re-run skipped existing files and only fetched/kept the two OFL licences OFL-CormorantGaramond.txt and OFL-Lora.txt from google/fonts main). Declared in pubspec exactly: CormorantGaramond Regular/SemiBold(600)/Italic and Lora Regular/Medium(500)/Italic; assets list the two OFL txts. All six verified TrueType, first bytes 00 01 00 00, sizes 134KB to 667KB; licences contain 'SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE'. Other user font files in assets/fonts (variable, Bold, Light, etc.) left untouched and undeclared. Geist TTFs and OFL.txt were deleted (before the network blocker). phosphor_flutter removed from pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock (pub get --offline). Final token names: AppTokens paper, ink, inkMuted, inkStrong, track, outline, hairline(0x29201F1D), accent, accentTint, accentInk, danger (+space, radii, text); AppSpacing screenMargin 26; AppRadii control 4, strip 20; AppTextTokens: kicker, displayTitle, displayNumeral, headline, dialogTitle, streakNumeral, rowTitle, numeral, numeralSmall, emptyState, body, bodySmall, caption, tiny, button, italicNote; family constants are AppTextTokens.headingFamily='CormorantGaramond' and AppTextTokens.bodyFamily='Lora' (NOT heading/body, because `body` is already a style getter). AppTheme.light() only; AppTheme.overlayStyle() now takes NO argument (light only). accent contrast on paper passes 3.0 as planned, no darkening needed. API surprises: kicker style bakes colour accentInk (as in plan); `body` name clash above; new_habit_button.dart kept as a simple OutlinedButton.icon (FEAT-003 deletes it); add_habit_page/points_picker use headline/displayNumeral with temporary fontSize/height copyWith to keep old layout metrics (a taller layout pushed a quick-pick chip off screen in the 800x600 test surface); FEAT-003 restyles. tnum: not checked in the bundled faces, harmless if absent. Tests: 326 passing (was 364; the 38 difference is the removed dark cases, see .agents/tasks/test-changes.md which was created). flutter analyze clean, architecture test green, dart format clean. grep for phosphor/FilledButton/darkTheme/AppTheme.dark in lib, pubspec.yaml returns nothing; in test/ it only matches test/design_rules_test.dart (ban rule + its self-test) and a `filledButtonTheme.style isNull` assertion in app_theme_test, both intentional. Hex colours exist only in app_tokens.dart. ENV: use the `fl` wrapper from FEAT-001 findings; `fl pub get --offline` works.
